QUOTE: "Note that the `handleX` methods do not write the database directly. The write is centralized in `batchRecords`. Any change to transaction behavior, error handling, or corruption detection there affects every handler"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says writes are centralized in `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, but it never says each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase. It also never ties the inheritance to that constraint.
